notes:
Inbound SMB fintech lead. Founder/CTO are ex-payments ops. Interested in hosted API first, wants VPC later once product-market fit.

Timeline:
- 2026-02-18: Signup via docs/download form (requested pricing + SOC2).
- 2026-02-20: AE outreach (Samira) — quick intro, asked for high-level perf numbers.
- 2026-02-25: Intro call — product overview, key use cases. CTO: "need predictable latency for chat-assisted underwriting".
- 2026-03-02: Tech deep-dive with SE (Lena) — discussed batching, KV cache, and model variants. CTO asked about quantized weights and token cost.
- 2026-03-09: Trial API key issued; smoke tests run against embeddings and chat endpoints. Initial embedding recall ~0.82 on internal dataset; chat outputs too verbose and need tuning.

Requirements summary (Customer stated):
- Workloads: real-time chat for underwriting and a searchable knowledge base (embeddings) for agent assist + transaction summarization.
- Latency target: median < 200–250ms for short-turn chat (<256 tokens); p95 < 600ms during normal load.
- Throughput: baseline ~10–20 qps, peaks to ~30 qps during business hours.
- Cost sensitivity: high — lean toward hosted but want tooling to control per-token spend.
- Model preferences: open models preferred for licensing; happy to try Redwood-curated LLMs / Llama-derivatives first.
- Security: SOC2 evidence and SSO/SAML are gating items; audit logs + KMS for keys required. Data residency: have EU customers, want clarity on where vectors are stored.

POC scope (proposed): 2-week hosted API POC — ingestion of 200k docs (embeddings), run 1k chat sessions through typical user flows, measure latency/cost and failure modes. Deliverables: perf/latency report, cost estimate and suggested batching/cache profiles.

Quotes / meeting notes:
- CTO (Ana Li): "We want to start on hosted — fastest path — but need to be able to move to VPC later without major code changes."
- Head of Ops: "Show us SOC2 controls and how you do key management — that's a blocker for procurement."

Action items / Next steps in CRM:
- Samira to send SOC2 one-pager + SSO integration checklist (by 2026-03-11).
- Lena to produce initial perf guidance and recommended model/quantization for their use-case (by 2026-03-12).
- Schedule POC kickoff 2026-03-15 pending budget ok.

Notes tone: concise, fragmented (CRM style). Repetition expected (security concerns repeated across stakeholders).
internal_risks: High security asks early; small ARR but expansion potential if POC shows cost savings; legal wants data residency clarity.
